partition_params_by_predicate: partition Haiku model parameters into two groups using a predicate function on module name or variable name
partition_n_params_into_groups: partition Haiku model parameters into N separate groups using an integer-valued function on each parameter
filter_params_by_predicate: filter Haiku model parameters to keep only those matching a predicate on module name or variable name
merge_param_structures: merge multiple Haiku parameter dictionaries into a single structure with optional duplicate checking
map_function_over_params: map a function over all Haiku model parameters to transform values by module name or variable name
traverse_param_structure: traverse a Haiku parameter structure and yield tuples of module name, variable name, and value for each leaf
check_param_subset: check whether one Haiku parameter structure is a subset of another parameter structure
